text.description_html:
Laurey 74610, Aventura Champagne Brass Cabinet Pull

The Small Champagne Brass Aventura Cabinet Pull is made out of zinc. This cabinet handle is a great choice for any home remodel project. The Champagne Brass finish is stunning. The Aventura Champagne Brass Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74610 96mm Pull Aventura Champagne Brass:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Champagne Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3-3/4" (96mm)
  • Overall Length: 4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
